# Plan Comparison Matrix — <short title>

**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Author:** independent scorer (must NOT be a plan author)
**Run folder:** `docs/aos/runs/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/`
**Artifact slot:** supplement to `03-options-or-council-plans.md`
**Companion governance:** `docs/governance/16-deliberative-planning-and-council-mode.md`,
`docs/governance/06-maker-checker-independent-review.md`

> The scorer applies the rubric below. Scores alone are insufficient —
> the scorer must also extract surviving ideas, rejected ideas,
> assumptions needing proof, contradictions with repo reality, scope
> concerns, execution concerns, and the most-cited buyer / engineer
> objection. Per `governance/16` the score is a discussion frame,
> not a verdict.

## Scoring rubric (1–10 per criterion)

| Criterion | Plan A | Plan B | Plan C | Plan D | Plan E | Plan F | Plan + |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Strategic clarity | | | | | | | |
| Market leadership potential | | | | | | | |
| User value | | | | | | | |
| Differentiation | | | | | | | |
| Evidence grounding | | | | | | | |
| Technical feasibility | | | | | | | |
| Scope discipline | | | | | | | |
| Risk management | | | | | | | |
| Commercial credibility | | | | | | | |
| Long-term extensibility | | | | | | | |
| **Total / 100** | | | | | | | |

- <plan that exceeds the Mission Brief's scope, with section ref>

  criteria>

## Execution concerns

- <named risk to delivery in the proposed time budget>
- <dependency that is not actually available>

## Most-cited objections

- <objection a skeptical buyer would raise>
- <objection a skeptical engineer would raise>
- <objection a skeptical compliance officer would raise>

## Recommendation to the synthesizer

A short paragraph naming the strongest set of surviving ideas, the
most important rejected ideas to preserve as warnings, and the
unresolved owner choices that the synthesized plan must surface
rather than silently decide.

## Scorer attestation

- [ ] I did not author any of the plans I am scoring.
- [ ] Every score has an extracted rationale (above).
- [ ] Every "rejected" idea has a citation (evidence item or repo
  fact).
- [ ] I will not also author the synthesized master plan.
- [ ] I will not also red-team the synthesized master plan.

## Anti-patterns rejected on sight

- Scoring all plans 7s and 8s without any divergent strength to
  preserve.
- Naming a "winning plan" rather than extracting surviving ideas
  for synthesis.
- Rejecting ideas without citing evidence.
- Recommending the synthesizer adopt a plan wholesale (Council Mode
  synthesizes, it does not pick).
